commands.name: dbshell
commands.description: Runs the command-line client for specified database, or the default database if none is provided.

commands.name: diffsettings
commands.description:
Displays differences between the current settings.py and Django's
    default settings.

commands.name: dumpdata
commands.description: Output the contents of the database as a fixture of the given format (using each model's default manager unless --all is specified).

commands.name: flush
commands.description: Removes ALL DATA from the database, including data added during migrations. Does not achieve a "fresh install" state.

commands.name: inspectdb
commands.description: Introspects the database tables in the given database and outputs a Django model module.

commands.name: loaddata
commands.description: Installs the named fixture(s) in the database.

commands.name: makemessages
commands.description:
Runs over the entire source tree of the current directory and pulls out all strings marked for translation. It creates (or updates) a message file in the conf/locale (in the django tree) or locale (for projects and applications) directory.

You must run this command with one of either the --locale, --exclude, or --all options.

commands.name: makemigrations
commands.description: Creates new migration(s) for apps.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Updates database schema. Manages both apps with migrations and those without.

commands.name: optimizemigration
commands.description: Optimizes the operations for the named migration.

commands.name: runserver
commands.description: Starts a lightweight web server for development and also serves static files.

commands.name: sendtestemail
commands.description: Sends a test email to the email addresses specified as arguments.

commands.name: shell
commands.description: Runs a Python interactive interpreter. Tries to use IPython or bpython, if one of them is available. Any standard input is executed as code.

commands.name: showmigrations
commands.description: Shows all available migrations for the current project

commands.name: sqlflush
commands.description: Returns a list of the SQL statements required to return all tables in the database to the state they were in just after they were installed.

commands.name: sqlmigrate
commands.description: Prints the SQL statements for the named migration.

commands.name: sqlsequencereset
commands.description: Prints the SQL statements for resetting sequences for the given app name(s).

commands.name: squashmigrations
commands.description: Squashes an existing set of migrations (from first until specified) into a single new one.

commands.name: startapp
commands.description: Creates a Django app directory structure for the given app name in the current directory or optionally in the given directory.

commands.name: startproject
commands.description: Creates a Django project directory structure for the given project name in the current directory or optionally in the given directory.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Discover and run tests in the specified modules or the current directory.

commands.name: testserver
commands.description: Runs a development server with data from the given fixture(s).

commands.name: collectstatic

commands.name: findstatic
